display_long_description:
Don't Blink is a multiplayer VR horror game by TripleCGames that drops you and your friends into the Backrooms — an endless expanse of flickering fluorescent lights, damp carpet, and the constant hum of something that should not be there.
Level 1 — The Office
Explore the iconic yellow-wallpapered corridors of Level 1 with up to 10 players. A relentless entity roams the halls, hunting by sight and sound. Coordinate with your team using real-time proximity voice chat — but be careful, it can hear you too.
Level 2 — The Labyrinth (Coming Soon)
Navigate a twisting maze where the monster freezes only when someone is watching it. With multiple players, survival becomes a coordination game — someone always has to be looking. The moment everyone looks away, it moves. Can your group keep eyes on it long enough to escape?
Features

Multiplayer VR horror for up to 10 players
Real-time proximity voice chat
Relentless AI entity with dynamic targeting and ambush behavior
Cosmetic customization system
Built ground-up for Meta Quest

More levels, entities, and game modes in development.
